test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements about Indian river systems is correct?

options.text: The Mahanadi river flows through the state of Chhattisgarh only.
Godavari river flows through Haryana state.
Yamuna River is a tributary of Ganga River.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Yamuna River is a tributary of Ganga River**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Yamuna River is one of the major rivers of northern India and the longest tributary of the Ganga River.
 
• It originates from the Yamunotri Glacier in the Himalayas in Uttarakhand.
 
• The Yamuna River flows through several states, including Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Delhi, and Uttar Pradesh, before merging with the Ganga at Allahabad (Prayagraj).
 
• The Yamuna River plays a crucial role in the irrigation and water supply of the regions it flows through, supporting agricultural activities and providing drinking water to millions of people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahanadi River**

 
 
• The Mahanadi River flows through the states of Chhattisgarh and Odisha, not just Chhattisgarh.
 
• It is one of the major rivers in eastern India and is known for the Hirakud Dam, one of the longest dams in the world.
 
 
 
• **Godavari River**
 
 
• The Godavari River is the second longest river in India and flows through the states of Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha.
 
• It does not flow through Haryana.
 
 
 
• **Sone River**
 
 
• The Sone River originates near Amarkantak in Madhya Pradesh, not in Punjab.
 
• It flows through the states of Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Bihar before joining the Ganga River.
